provenance.instrument: Lower Merion Township Code, Chapter 155 Zoning (amended in its entirety 2-26-2020 by Ord. No. 4181), 155-10.2C Restricted accessory dwelling units, Table 5.1 and 5.3, 155-7.1 Tables 7.1.1 and 7.1.2, 155-4.1 and 155-4.2 form standards, Table 8.1 parking
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 says the code includes legislation through 06-17-2026. New Laws (3) are all Chapter 145 traffic amendments. Table 5.1 last amended 9-17-2025 by Ord. No. 4316.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: includes legislation through 06-17-2026. New Laws (3), all Chapter 145.
checks: Restricted ADU: everyone in both units must be related by blood, marriage or legal adoption, or be domestic partners (155-10.2C(1))
One unit holds at most two persons, one of them 62 or older (155-10.2C(2))
The owner records an agreement with the Township to remove the separate kitchen when no longer used this way. The permit expires six months after elderly occupancy ends (155-10.2C(3) and (7))
An annual Township permit is required (155-10.2C(8))
One unit must have at least twice the occupied floor area of the other (155-10.2C(9))
Owner-occupied, or sponsored by a nonprofit whose purpose is housing for the elderly (155-10.2C(10))

Path by district: special exception in LDR and MDR (Tables 5.1 and 5.3). By right in IC and IH, where Table 5.2 marks 'Alternative housing for the elderly' P. In a Class 1 Historic Resource in LDR, conditional use (Table 5.3 note (2))

Size: 'One dwelling unit shall have no less than two times the square footage of occupied space than the other' (155-10.2C(9)). For a unit carved out of the house, the ADU is at most about one third of the house. For a unit in an accessory structure, at most half of the house. The file stores the stricter one third

Lot area: MDR1 requires '4,000 square feet minimum per unit' and special exception uses follow district dimensions (155-5.2D). Reading: a house plus ADU in MDR1 needs 8,000 sq ft. Ask the Zoning Officer
155-2.1 defines ACCESSORY STRUCTURE as 'A nonhabitable structure' but 155-10.2C(6) places a unit 'in an accessory structure'. ACCESSORY BUILDING is defined as habitable. Read as an accessory building
Table 5.1 'Alternative housing for the elderly' covers all of 155-10.2, including C, the restricted ADU

Historic path (Class 1 or Class 2 Historic Resource): 'Accessory dwelling unit' is R in Table 7.1.1. Zoning permit from the Zoning Officer (155-7.1D(2), 7.1B(4)(d)). No family or age rule. Conditions: the only single-family unit besides the principal dwelling (Table 7.1.2), parking per Table 8.1, the unit 'contained within the historic buildings or structures unless otherwise specifically permitted' (7.1B(4)(a)), a Historical Commission or HARB recommendation if in a historic district (7.1B(4)(b)), a conservation easement or covenant first (7.1B(3)), and only one additional use on the property (7.1C(2)). The schema has no field for this path, so approval.path shows the general special exception. Confirm with the Zoning Officer
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Building and Planning Department, Zoning Officer. Pending: no ADU amendment found. Nothing in New Laws for Chapter 155.

term.note: 155-10.2C 'Restricted accessory dwelling units'. 155-2.1 also defines 'accessory dwelling unit', used in the historic resource tables.

status.note: Relatives only, with one person 62 or older, by special exception in LDR and MDR. Historic resources have a separate by-permit path.

path.note: 'Alternative housing for the elderly' is S in LDR and MDR. 'A use permitted by special exception requires the approval of the Zoning Hearing Board' (155-5.1E(4)). By right in IC and IH (Table 5.2). Historic resources: zoning permit, see checks.

fallback_path.note: A unit for non-relatives is not a listed use outside historic resources. Reading: a use variance.

zoning_districts.note: 'In LDR, MDR, IC, and IH Zoning Districts'. Table 5.1 marks S in LDR and MDR.

building_types.note: 'a single-family dwelling or an existing institutional building may be converted into two dwelling units'. Single-family detached is the single-family type in LDR.

min_lot_sqft.note: No ADU lot size. District lot area applies.

existing_structure_only.note: A single-family dwelling 'may be converted'. C(6) allows the unit in an accessory structure. New construction is not addressed.

historic_bypass.note: Class 1 and Class 2 Historic Resources: 'Accessory dwelling unit' is R, by zoning permit. Inside the historic buildings, HARB or Historical Commission recommendation, covenant first. No family or age rule. See checks.

types_allowed.note: Conversion of the house into two units, or a unit 'located in an accessory structure'. A new detached building or an addition is not addressed.

max_share_of_house.note: 'One dwelling unit shall have no less than two times the square footage of occupied space than the other.' A unit carved out of the house is at most about one third of it. A unit in an accessory structure may be up to half of the house.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory building: 2 stories up to 20 ft. Reading: a unit in an accessory structure meets principal setbacks, so the 20 ft cap applies, not the 15 ft cap for reduced setbacks (155-3.4F(2)).

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit converted inside the house is in the principal building, so the principal height applies (35 ft in LDR).

setback_front_ft.note: Accessory buildings 'shall be erected to the rear of the principal building'.

setback_side_ft.note: 'the accessory structure shall comply with the principal building setbacks in the underlying zoning district'. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: Principal building rear setback applies. See districts.

max_impervious.note: LDR1 20%, LDR2 21%, LDR3 28%, LDR4 45%, MDR1 to MDR3 50% for single-family.

owner_occupancy.note: Owner-occupied or nonprofit-sponsored. 'If the facility is not owner-occupied, its use shall be sponsored by a nonprofit organization' for elderly housing.

family_only.note: 'All individuals living in the dwelling units are related by blood, marriage or legal adoption or are domestic partners.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: Not addressed. Family-only occupancy rules out renting to others.

max_adus.note: 'converted into two dwelling units', so one ADU.

spaces_required.note: Single-family housing (detached), LDR and MDR: '2/unit + 1 space/ADU'. 155-8.1B(3) counts ADUs.
